'''Greg Bond''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals]] on 5 August 2000 with Ties and [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|DBO]], according to Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1137">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-hoth-north-ridge-regional-calgaryd1137/ hoth-north-ridge-regional-calgary], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-hoth-north-ridge-regional-calgaryd1137/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
